tooling_findings.readme_reader: scripts/computed-route/lib/read-readme.mjs::readReadme splits sections and keeps judgement calls, open items and business details only; no README number, colour, timing or interaction is turned into a setting ("The README does not address elements").
tooling_findings.tokens: scripts/computed-route/lib/tokens.mjs::readTokens reads tokens/*.css; snapshot receives palette, gradients, fonts, spacing, gutter, section, radius and easing; --shadow-button/-card/-panel/-header are classified as shadows (tokenType) but absent from theme-snapshot.json.
tooling_findings.animations: animations.json records are consumed by lib/read-animations.mjs and fill-motion*.mjs; mega entrance (A-13), mega stagger (A-12), drawer stagger and social hover have no target setting.
tooling_findings.site_options: sites/indus-foods/build/site-options.json cites A-12 for page transitions (record is the mega stagger; route fade is A-10).
